provenance.test_use: One evaluation pass per mode after dev-only threshold selection. Same project authors wrote corpus and benchmark; not independent validation.
provenance.answer_method: deterministic verbatim extractive baseline; optional LLM not scored here
provenance.latency: Wall-clock answer() time; model/index warmup excluded; sequential local runs; hardware-specific.
provenance.metric_caveats: Sentence support is verbatim membership, not entailment or relevance. Topic-term fraction is a broad topic diagnostic, not exact match or correctness. Macro retrieval recall uses answerable queries only. Bootstrap CIs are query-level percentile intervals, small authored sample, not a population guarantee.
